description: This file contains unit tests for the LogicalNode class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.rql.predicates.ast package. It verifies core functionalities such as constructors, toString output, equality, and visitor pattern acceptance.

classes.name: LogicalNodeTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing LogicalNode behavior.

methods.description: Ensures that constructing LogicalNode with null throws NullPointerException.
